SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS QUOTATION_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS QUOTATION_SEQ FROM KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFDOWN' AND NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),'T') = 'T' GROUP BY KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KOLN' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(KEY_3,0) AS REVISION, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(DESCRIPTIONG,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(SPECIFICATION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, NVL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, NVL(REQ_USER_TELNO,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, NVL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(END_DATE,' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, NVL(ITEM_QTY, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(KEY_4,' ') AS REF_IF_NO FROM KII_PO_KEP_RFQ_V, KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE KEY_1 = QUOTATION_NO(+) AND KEY_2 = QUOTATION_SEQ(+) AND TO_NUMBER(KEY_3) = REVISION_NO(+) AND KEY_4 = LEGACY_PR_NO(+) AND DOC_NAME = 'RFDOWN' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),'T') = 'T' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2
UPDATE KII_PO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFDOWN' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),'T') = 'T'
